summary: FirstEnergy Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Fifth Amended and Restated LLC Agreement for its subsidiary FET, with its joint venture partner Brookfield. The filing amends FET's governance to cover two new transmission joint ventures (Valley Link and Grid Growth) but does not change existing ownership percentages (FirstEnergy retains 50.1%; Brookfield 49.9%), board composition, or consent thresholds. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation event; it is a routine governance amendment to align existing agreements with new projects. The filing contains no deal terms, price, premium, or breakup fee. This is a standard operational update, not a special situation.
